prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate exactly ONE new image: a finished portrait xianxia game background for "Dai La Thien", the highest heaven. Target approximately 9:16 portrait (e.g. 941 x 1672). Full-bleed opaque PNG.
Rendering-quality reference only: the attached two-realms.png has painterly semi-realistic xianxia environment art, refined atmospheric depth, richly nuanced light, detailed natural textures and elegant portrait framing. Match that level of polished game-background painting, but design an entirely NEW location with no mountain scene.
Scene: a vast celestial observatory platform floating in deep space. Upper 70 percent of the image is an immense starry cosmos, a brilliant spiral galaxy arm sweeping diagonally through the upper sky, colourful deep-blue, violet and teal nebulae with faint gold, thousands of fine stars, and just a few very distant, small jade-and-gold celestial palace silhouettes floating far away near the sides. Majestic cosmic scale, grander than any mountain scene.
Lower 30 percent: the top surface of a grand circular platform made of dark star-metal and white jade, seen at a slight angle. The platform is large and extends across the foreground, its visual centre at x=50%, y=78% of the whole image, leaving room for a game character to stand there later. Subtle engraved concentric astronomical rings and faint delicate star-chart lines in the platform surface; thin gold rails ONLY at the far edge. No tall foreground structures.
Composition: keep the central column x=35–65%, y=40–85% relatively clean and calm, with low visual clutter and restrained brightness so a character silhouette reads clearly. Put the galaxy's brightest detailed region in the upper portion, and ornamental complexity toward the sides. The empty standing point at 78% height must be clearly supported by the platform surface. Cinematic celestial light softly reflects in white jade and dark metal. Painterly semi-realistic fantasy art, beautifully resolved, dignified and monumental.
No characters, no people, no creatures, no constellation figures or constellation-shaped beings, no text, no lettering, no UI, no watermark. No borders.
